lead.t: Laboratory abnormalities in hypothyroidism may include hyponatremia, macrocytic anemia, hypercholesterolemia, and elevated creatine phosphokinase.\nChildren with suspected hypothyroidism should undergo measurement of serum TSH and free T4.
